ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity (black) zone extending from the notch into the interior of both lobes, transitioning into high-intensity (white) fields that cover the distal areas, with dense speckled mottling along the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge, characterized by pixel-amplitude variations of 5-12 pixels, appearing most jagged near the outer lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge transition to a sigmoid trailing edge curve, showing distinct concavity adjacent to the median notch and transitioning to convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular/cylindrical calcified structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear disruptions; a prominent near-vertical mark in the left high-intensity field and multiple diagonal unaligned scratches across the central pigmented transition zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) on terminal tips; presence of multiple parallel vertical rake-like scars across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained salt-and-pepper stippling pattern concentrated at the interface boundaries between the white and black pigmentation fields.
